title: A sandwich ELISA
caption: A capture antibody on the plate binds the antigen from the sample, a second, enzyme-labelled antibody binds it from above, and washing removes everything unbound between steps. The enzyme turns a substrate into a coloured product whose absorbance, read against a standard curve, gives the concentration.
alt: Five boxes in order: coat the plate with capture antibody, add the sample, add the enzyme-labelled detection antibody, add the substrate, and read the absorbance.
description: Coat the plate: a capture antibody sticks to the wells.
Add the sample: the antigen binds the capture antibody; wash.
Add the detection antibody: an enzyme-labelled antibody binds the antigen; wash.
Add the substrate: the enzyme turns it into a coloured product.
Read the absorbance: a plate reader; unknowns are read off a standard curve.
